notes.title: DEVIL 2 NEWS!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36271051/0d77138cf7a1f9c4c9cf3af5c4b40305826775f2.png"]Dear friends,


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36271051/fc8c88303333c72756ffb5c2c4b5daab292f6189.jpg"]


We would like to share with you some early materials from the second part of "Sex with the Devil"!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36271051/8f97033bf7526c67b58abb71ee3c5cc7174a962a.jpg"]


Here is a fragment of the text (without proofreading and editing) and some concept arts.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398007/78ad992b5d2ff8b3c7e76d34c5ab705bdf57f74e.jpg"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36271051/b2c3d73562a4cf27b42ba391169c3af909386eee.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398007/41964d06ba4c8396420cf4cafacd11b0348e3d06.jpg"]



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36271051/90ca29c675c4aa38e8249e676b165a7c9747e06c.png"]
 Also, do not forget about the upcoming release of the "Futa Runner" game! If you could add it to your wishlist, it would be a great help for us!!! 

If the release is successful, we will be able to add a lot of new content to the Devil's sequel!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36271051/f868109e11a42d3c28bbba21fd7c54e77aca117c.jpg"] Thank you for your support!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398007/b16249e80566b628ac6c45c7db300cb699c68e5e.jpg"]

notes.title: Interactive teaser of our new game is now available!

notes.title: SEX, PLEASE!
notes.content:
Dear friends!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36271051/b0e0322353ea226fbc8b01db33723a130949c0e2.png

It's time to share the news with you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36271051/4c6ee44d76cecaf35cb8f0a15793fa6989e38c69.png

The development of "Sex with the Devil 2" is going slowly because we need to develop  a large number of animated battle scenes and circus sex shows. We spend two months for one such scene.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36271051/9fc65bc3a1b4c34aa8c7999e8a9a974153fbce72.png

Release of the sequel will take place only in the middle or end of 2024.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36271051/06c92f20da9f53f8dff8bbf1af3ed334d7593988.png

But to brighten your waiting, we decided to create a small, but very unusual game! It focuses on sex scenes, not on plot cut-scenes with battles. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36271051/52036329df6750f3f758c94f5ffeeccc91326081.png

We present to your attention - "Sex, Please".

You can add "Sex, Please" to your Wishlist now!
